question.instructions: Assign the minimum AO3 fiction rating appropriate for the finished story text. Judge the most intense material actually depicted on the page, including its detail and frequency. A theme, identity, relationship, or intended audience alone does not raise the rating.

criteria.General: Suitable for all ages; mild or non-graphic content.
criteria.Teen: May be unsuitable for readers under 13; moderate threat, violence, language, or suggestive material without adult-level detail.
criteria.Mature: Adult themes or stronger violence or sexual material, but without the detailed sexual activity or graphic violence of Explicit.
criteria.Explicit: Detailed sexual activity, graphic violence, or similarly explicit adult content depicted on the page.

input: Finished story prose only; existing ratings and covers omitted from Jev requests.
